title: 新建区域枢纽，怎样向合作方讲清投资价值？
topic: 把区域连接、处理能力和客户结果连成投资理由

source.title: FedEx Announces Plans to Develop New Integrated Air Cargo Hub at GMR Cargo City, Delhi Airport
source.section: FedEx Announces Plans to Develop New Integrated Air Cargo Hub at GMR Cargo City, Delhi Airport
source.type: FedEx 官方区域枢纽投资与运营规划公告
source.context: FedEx 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: Delhi, 25 August 2026: Federal Express Corporation (“FedEx”) today announced plans to develop a new integrated air cargo hub at GMR Cargo City at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport, further strengthening its connectivity across North and East India and linking businesses in these markets with destinations across its global network.

The proposed facility represents a long-term investment of approximately US$150 million by FedEx. Spread across approximately 230,000 square feet, the fully automated integrated air cargo hub is designed to bring international gateway and pickup-and-delivery operations together within a single facility, enabling greater operational efficiency and faster, more seamless movement of shipments.
Once operational, the hub is designed to increase processing capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour, with the flexibility to scale further as demand grows.

The facility is planned to feature an advanced auto-sorter, latest-generation X-ray machines and enhanced security systems, alongside intelligent package-handling technologies. These capabilities will support efficient and reliable shipment movement, strengthen network resilience and enhance the customer experience.

Kami Viswanathan, president, FedEx Middle East, Indian Subcontinent and Africa (MEISA), said, “India is a critical market in our global network, with North and East India playing an important role in the country’s growing trade and economic opportunity. Strengthening our presence in Delhi will enhance connectivity across these markets and support businesses as they grow and expand. It reflects our long-term confidence in India and our commitment to investing in the capacity and capabilities needed to support the country’s evolving trade needs.”

The planned investment builds on continued efforts to strengthen infrastructure across India. By investing in strategically located facilities and advanced capabilities, FedEx is expanding network capacity and connectivity to support customers and India’s growing role in global trade.
translations: 8 月 25 日，新德里：联邦快递公司宣布计划在德里英迪拉·甘地国际机场的 GMR Cargo City 建设一座新的综合航空货运枢纽，进一步加强其在印度北部和东部的网络连接，并将这些市场的企业与其全球网络目的地连接起来。
拟建的设施是 FedEx 一项约 1.5 亿美元的长期投资项目。这个面积约 23 万平方英尺的全自动综合航空货运枢纽，旨在将国际货运门户和揽收配送运营整合在同一设施内，从而提升运营效率，让货物运输更快、更顺畅。
枢纽投入运营后，设计处理能力将从每小时 600 件提升到 5,000 件，并可随着需求增长进一步扩展。
该设施计划配置先进自动分拣机、最新一代 X 光机和增强型安检系统，以及智能包裹处理技术。这些能力将支持高效、可靠的货运流转，增强网络韧性并改善客户体验。
FedEx 中东、印度次大陆和非洲区总裁 Kami Viswanathan 表示：“印度是我们全球网络中的关键市场，印度北部和东部在不断增长的贸易和经济机会中发挥重要作用。加强我们在德里的布局将提升这些市场的连接能力，并支持企业成长和拓展。这体现了我们对印度的长期信心，以及我们投资建设所需产能和能力、支持印度贸易需求变化的承诺。”
这项计划投资是在 FedEx 持续加强印度基础设施基础上的进一步投入。通过投资地理位置战略重要的设施和先进能力，FedEx 正在扩大网络产能和连接能力，以支持客户需求，并助力印度在全球贸易中发挥日益重要的作用。
fullTextParagraphs: Delhi, 25 August 2026: Federal Express Corporation (“FedEx”) today announced plans to develop a new integrated air cargo hub at GMR Cargo City at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport, further strengthening its connectivity across North and East India and linking businesses in these markets with destinations across its global network.

The proposed facility represents a long-term investment of approximately US$150 million by FedEx. Spread across approximately 230,000 square feet, the fully automated integrated air cargo hub is designed to bring international gateway and pickup-and-delivery operations together within a single facility, enabling greater operational efficiency and faster, more seamless movement of shipments.
Once operational, the hub is designed to increase processing capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour, with the flexibility to scale further as demand grows.
The groundbreaking ceremony was graced by Shri Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu, Hon’ble Minister of Civil Aviation, Government of India.

The facility is planned to feature an advanced auto-sorter, latest-generation X-ray machines and enhanced security systems, alongside intelligent package-handling technologies. These capabilities will support efficient and reliable shipment movement, strengthen network resilience and enhance the customer experience.

Kami Viswanathan, president, FedEx Middle East, Indian Subcontinent and Africa (MEISA), said, “India is a critical market in our global network, with North and East India playing an important role in the country’s growing trade and economic opportunity. Strengthening our presence in Delhi will enhance connectivity across these markets and support businesses as they grow and expand. It reflects our long-term confidence in India and our commitment to investing in the capacity and capabilities needed to support the country’s evolving trade needs.”

GMR Cargo City is being developed as an integrated, future-ready cargo and logistics ecosystem at Delhi Airport, bringing together global logistics players, cargo operators and allied services within a strategically located airport-based platform. Designed to strengthen Delhi’s position as a leading air cargo gateway and support India’s growing trade, e-commerce and express logistics requirements, the 50-acre development has a total potential of approximately 1.5 to 2 million square feet. Phase 1 will comprise approximately 1 million square feet of development across nearly 30 acres. The detailed design for Phase 1 has been finalised by leading consultants, enabling works have commenced, and construction is expected to begin shortly.

The proposed FedEx integrated air cargo hub marks a significant milestone in this vision, reinforcing GMR Cargo City’s role as a preferred destination for world-class logistics infrastructure and seamless global connectivity.

Rajesh Arora, President & CEO – Commercial & Growth, GMR Airports Ltd., said: “FedEx’s decision to develop its new integrated air cargo hub at GMR Cargo City is a strong endorsement of Delhi Airport’s growing stature as a strategic global logistics gateway. GMR Cargo City is being developed as an integrated ecosystem that brings together world-class infrastructure, technology and leading logistics partners to enable faster, smarter and more seamless cargo movement. This facility will further strengthen Delhi’s role in connecting businesses across North and East India with global markets, while supporting the country’s expanding trade and e-commerce ambitions. We are proud to partner with FedEx in this significant development and look forward to enabling the next phase of growth in India’s air cargo and logistics ecosystem.”

The planned investment builds on continued efforts to strengthen infrastructure across India. By investing in strategically located facilities and advanced capabilities, FedEx is expanding network capacity and connectivity to support customers and India’s growing role in global trade.

notes.phrase: further strengthening its connectivity across North and East India
notes.meaning: 进一步加强在印度北部和东部的网络连接。
notes.explain: strengthen connectivity 指增强区域网络与业务连接。
notes.example: The new route will strengthen connectivity across the region.

notes.phrase: represents a long-term investment of approximately US$150 million
notes.meaning: 代表 FedEx 一项约 1.5 亿美元的长期投资。
notes.explain: approximately 表示约数；这是计划投资金额。
notes.example: The project represents a long-term investment of $80 million.

notes.phrase: increase processing capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour
notes.meaning: 把处理能力从每小时 600 件提升到 5,000 件。

notes.meaning: 增强网络韧性并改善客户体验。

notes.example: The backup site will strengthen network resilience.

scenario.title: 模拟情境：投资委员会要求说明枢纽价值
english: A new cargo hub is proposed for a fast-growing trade region.
The plan would bring gateway and pickup-and-delivery operations into one facility, but the investment is long term.
Explain the network opportunity, the expected capacity change, and the measures to review after the hub opens.
chinese: 公司计划在一个贸易快速增长的区域建设货运枢纽。
方案将把国际门户和揽收配送整合在一处，但这是一项长期投资。
请说明网络机会、预计产能变化，以及枢纽开放后要复盘的指标。

firstAttempt.prompt: 公司计划投入约 1.5 亿美元建设航空货运枢纽。请用英语说明它将连接哪些业务、预计怎样提升处理能力，以及投入运营后要观察什么结果。
firstAttempt.sample: The proposed hub will bring international gateway and pickup-and-delivery operations together in one facility. Once operational, it is designed to increase processing capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour and strengthen connectivity across North and East India. We should review throughput, on-time movement, and network resilience after launch.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说明设施整合的运营环节，再引用计划产能变化，最后提出投入运营后的验证指标。

words.example: The new hub will increase processing capacity during peak periods.
words.translation: 新枢纽将在高峰期提升处理能力。
words.note: 常用于货运、仓储、客服等运营场景。

words.meaning: 吞吐量；单位时间处理量
words.example: We will track package throughput by hour.
words.translation: 我们会按小时跟踪包裹吞吐量。
words.note: 描述一定时间内完成的货物或业务量。

words.example: The additional route improves network resilience.
words.translation: 新增路线提升了网络韧性。
words.note: 指业务在中断或需求波动时维持、恢复运行的能力。

taskPhrases.word: bring operations together in one facility
taskPhrases.meaning: 把运营环节整合在同一设施内
taskPhrases.example: The site will bring sorting and dispatch together in one facility.
taskPhrases.translation: 该场地会把分拣和发运整合在同一设施内。

taskPhrases.word: increase capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour
taskPhrases.meaning: 把处理能力从每小时 600 件提升到 5,000 件
taskPhrases.collocation: increase + capacity + from A to B
taskPhrases.example: The hub is designed to increase capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour.
taskPhrases.translation: 枢纽设计处理能力将从每小时 600 件提升到每小时 5,000 件。

taskPhrases.example: Once the hub is operational, we can review delivery performance.
taskPhrases.translation: 枢纽投入运营后，我们可以复盘配送表现。

structure.original: Once operational, the hub is designed to increase processing capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour, with the flexibility to scale further as demand grows.
analysis: Once operational 是 once the hub is operational 的省略形式，说明产能变化发生的条件。
from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour 把变化前后和单位说清楚。
with the flexibility to scale further 补充说明未来扩容能力。
structure.transfer: Once the new service center is operational, it can process twice as many requests per day and scale further as demand grows.

rewrite.bad: The new hub will make everything faster and better.
rewrite.good: The proposed hub will bring international gateway and pickup-and-delivery operations together in one facility. Once operational, it is designed to increase processing capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour. We will review throughput, on-time movement, and network resilience after launch.
rewrite.translation: 计划中的枢纽会把国际门户和揽收配送运营整合在同一设施内。投入运营后，设计处理能力将从每小时 600 件提升到 5,000 件。我们会在启用后复盘吞吐量、按时运输情况和网络韧性。
rewrite.pattern: The proposed [facility] will bring [operations] together. Once operational, it is designed to increase [measure] from [A] to [B].

cloze.prompt: The hub is designed to increase processing capacity from 600 ______ 5,000 packages per hour.
cloze.why: from A to B 表示从 A 提升到 B。

cloze.prompt: The new site will bring operations together in one ______.
Once the hub is ______, we will review delivery performance.
cloze.why: once operational 表示投入运营后。

dictation.label: 听写 1
dictation.text: Once operational, the hub is designed to increase processing capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour.
dictation.why: 注意先说运营条件，再说从多少提升到多少。

apply.prompt: 枢纽投入运营后，我们会复盘处理能力。
apply.sample: Once the hub is operational, we will review processing capacity.

dictation.label: 听写 2
dictation.text: The planned facility will strengthen connectivity across North and East India.
dictation.why: 留意 planned facility 表示计划建设的设施。

apply.prompt: 新枢纽会提升区域连接能力。
apply.sample: The new hub will strengthen regional connectivity.

translationPractice.prompt: 该场地会把分拣和发运整合在同一设施内。
translationPractice.answer: The site will bring sorting and dispatch together in one facility.
translationPractice.why: bring A and B together 表示把两个运营环节整合在一起。

translationPractice.prompt: 枢纽设计处理能力将从每小时 600 件提升到每小时 5,000 件。
translationPractice.answer: The hub is designed to increase capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour.
translationPractice.why: 用 increase capacity from A to B 描述处理能力变化，并保留来源中的单位和数值。

translationPractice.prompt: 枢纽投入运营后，我们可以复盘配送表现。
translationPractice.answer: Once the hub is operational, we can review delivery performance.
translationPractice.why: once operational 表示投入运营后。

choice.prompt: 区域枢纽仍在规划中，预计建成后处理能力提升。向合作方汇报时，哪种表述准确？
options: The new hub is already processing 5,000 packages every hour.
Once operational, the hub is designed to increase processing capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour.
The hub guarantees that every shipment will arrive on time.
choice.why: 第二条明确说明这是投入运营后的设计产能，不把未来计划说成已经实现，也没有承诺绝对结果。

output.prompt: 请向投资委员会汇报区域枢纽项目。说明整合的运营环节、计划产能变化，以及投入运营后要复盘的指标。
output.sample: The proposed hub will bring international gateway and pickup-and-delivery operations together in one facility. Once operational, it is designed to increase processing capacity from 600 to 5,000 packages per hour. We should review throughput, on-time movement, and network resilience after launch, then adjust capacity as demand grows.
check: 说清将整合的运营环节
准确使用计划中的产能数字和单位
提出投入运营后的复盘指标
